titleText.es: La función de la Wikipedia como extensión cerebral, aunque un poco problemática, también mola mucho.
titleText.en: Wikipedia's role as brain-extension, while a little troubling, is also really cool.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish title text uses the colloquial phrase mola mucho for “is really cool.”

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you refer to sexual play, including activity that builds arousal before intercourse?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use juego sexual for sexual play; depending on context, it can refer to foreplay.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Juego sexual is broader than English “foreplay”: it can name different kinds of consensual sexual activity, so the surrounding context determines whether “foreplay” is the best English meaning.

example.es: Hablaron de sus preferencias para el juego sexual.
example.en: They talked about their preferences for sexual play.

applications.explanationEn: Juego and sexual form the fixed topic label; the shared card explains the expression's range without adding any surrounding sentence.
